board_source.document: Nokia NSE-8/9 System Module Service Manual, issue 1, 07/99

channels.typical_scale: 4.7 mV/bit; the default represents about 3.31 V
channels.consumer: early five-sample reader 0x2a84b0 and task-18 accepted window 0x2be..0x314
source-7 monitor, voltage calibration and 2100-unit shutdown floor; scalar reader 0x2a68c4 has 11 classified callers
channels.constraint: the corresponding standard-DCT3 source uses selector 2/VBAT, but NSE-8 routes it to selector 1 even though the service manual does not identify a second battery pin

channels.typical_scale: 6.5 mV/bit; the default represents about 3.3 V
4.7 mV/bit; manual uncalibrated reading at 2.7 V
channels.consumer: independent reader at 0x2a90b4; this is not a battery-pack BSI resistor on NSE-8

channels.typical_scale: manual NTC table reading at 25 C
channels.consumer: five classified init-mode callers plus independent charge-fault reader 0x2a90ac
six-sample charger debounce at 0x2b084c with raw threshold 0x64
logical source 3 route and direct service/measurement readers
logical source 4 route and one early initialization sample; no organic charger-edge reread

timing.firmware_contract: write control, poll GENSIO status, read result registers
timing.sample_contract: the control write latches one ten-bit result for the subsequent LSB/MSB reads
timing.hardware_synchronization: the service manual says CCONT conversion is synchronized to TXP
timing.closure: physical conversion duration is not recoverable from these ROMs: the helper observes only GENSIO transfer readiness and has no ADC-ready status, interrupt or delay operation
